decision_conditions:
The Development hereby permitted shall only be carried out and completed strictly in accordance with the submitted plans hereby approved and any subsequent approval of details.


REASON: To ensure that the development hereby permitted is carried out in full accordance with the plans hereby approved.

<p>Prior to the first occupation of the development hereby approved the cycle and refuse storage facilities and shower/changing facilities shall be provided in full and retained in perpetuity thereafter.</p><p>REASON: In the interests of promoting sustainable transport.</p>

<p>Prior to occupation of the development hereby approved, a full air permeability test report confirming all units have achieved an air permeability of 8 m3/h/m2@50pa as set out in the hereby approved Energy Statement (prepared by Verte dated January 2024) shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.</p><p>REASON: In the interest of addressing climate change and securing sustainable and net zero development and construction.</p>

<p>Within 6 months of commencement of the development hereby approved, the BREEAM Interim Design Certificate shall be submitted to and approved by the local planning authority, providing full details to demonstrate at least the following standards have been met, as set out in the hereby approved BREEAM pre-assessment (dated November 2022, prepared by Verte) - targeted credits must be presented in a tracker comparing credits targeted at BREEAM pre-assessment stage:</p><p>(a)Minimum BREEAM Rating of Excellent</p><p>The development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with the details thereby approved.&nbsp;</p><p>Within 6 months of occupation of the development, the BREEAM Final Design Certificate confirming an ‘Excellent Rating’ shall be submitted to and approved by the local planning authority, providing full details confirming the final rating and credits have been achieved or improved upon the pre-commencement figures - achieved credits must be presented in a tracker comparing credits achieved at BREEAM Interim Certification stage.</p><p><br></p><p>REASON: In the interest of addressing climate change and securing sustainable and net zero development and construction.</p>

<p>Full details of the location of the condenser units from Air Source Heat Pumps (ASHP) (or any other related fixed plant adopted), shall be submitted to and approved by the local planning authority, in writing prior to the installation of the relevant parts to demonstrate at least the following standards been achieved or improved upon as set out in the hereby approved Energy Statement (prepared by Verte dated July 2022). The ASHP thereby approved shall be installed prior to occupation of the development.</p><p>REASON: In the interest of addressing climate change and securing sustainable and net zero development and construction.</p>

<p>The noise level from all plant and machinery included in the approved development shall at all times remain 5dB(A) below background levels when measured at any nearby residential window or other sensitive receptor if appropriate (add/delete as appropriate)</p><p><br></p><p>REASON: To ensure that occupiers of neighbouring premises do not suffer a loss of amenity by reason of noise nuisance and other excess noise.</p>
